description: Main window permissions. No shell, fs, or dialog plugin access for the webview: the sidecar is spawned from Rust, and the vault is only reachable through the vault commands, which confine every path to the folder the user picked (src-tauri/src/vault.rs). Portal webviews load remote https sites; this capability has no remote entry, so those pages cannot call any command (src-tauri/src/portal.rs). The Terminal tab can run anything the user types: the terminal commands drive up to five shells spawned from Rust (src-tauri/src/terminal.rs).
